title: Line charts drew the value axis horizontally

found.context: Stage 4 end-to-end run (private project; reproduced synthetically)

observed_failure: The renderer placed value ticks and the value label on the horizontal axis, which encodes the step, so a figure read as 'value vs value'. No visual gate noticed.
expected_behavior: The value axis of a line chart is vertical, and any figure whose marks disagree with its labelled value axis fails V3 (renderer-independent).
lessons: Checkers written by the renderer's author share its blind spots; a blind human-like reader caught it.
